notes: All integer values are decimal strings (BigInt-safe beyond 2^53).
hex strings are lowercase, no separators.
MOQT varint (leading-ones length, 1..9 bytes), NOT the QUIC varint.
Control message Length is a fixed 16-bit big-endian field.

ops: decode = bytes must parse to the given semantics; encode = semantics must serialize to exactly these bytes (minimal varints unless pad_len); reject = bytes must be refused with the given error; decode_varint = a bare varint, not a full structure.

kvp.name: kvp_delta_overflow
kvp.note: prev + delta exceeds 2^64-1; C check: delta > UINT64_MAX - prev

kvp.name: kvp_len_too_big
kvp.note: odd-type Length 65536 > 2^16-1, rejected before reading data

kvp.name: kvp_truncated_raw
kvp.note: Length 3 but only 1 value byte inside the known bound

kvp.name: kvp_len_65535_with_data
kvp.note: boundary accept: Length 65535 with 65535 data bytes (byte i = i mod 256)

kvp.name: kvp_len_65536_with_data
kvp.note: Length 65536 rejected even though 65536 data bytes are present

data.name: subgroup_stream_status_eog
data.note: object_id = prev + delta + 1 after the first; Status present only when Payload Length is 0

data.name: stream_type_unknown
data.note: unknown stream type: close the session

name.name: ftn_4096_accept
name.note: sum of field lengths + name length == 4096 (boundary accept)
